_comment: Mapping of the master 01 test data to the data that really exists on the hosted UAT environment. Edit here, not in the tests. Every value can also be overridden by an environment variable (see core/config.py).

admin_login._comment: microsoft = button 'Sign in with Microsoft' then pick the test account tile (no password). password = username + password from UAT_HQ_PASS / UAT_SCHOOL_PASS.
